## MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the Current Market Regime?**
RISK-ON: Normal volatility (Vol: 29.3%) with broad participation (Breadth: 7/8 sectors positive). Market is driven by a bank-led rally and selective industrial strength.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Banking & Finance leading: AKBNK (1W: +11.89% | 1M: +1.32%) ABOVE TREND, YKBNK (1W: +14.82% | 1M: +0.60%) ABOVE TREND, ISCTR (1W: +11.62% | 1M: +9.29%) ABOVE TREND. Construction & REIT also strong: TKFEN (1W: +13.34% | 1M: +22.02%) ABOVE TREND; Transportation showing a rebound: TAVHL (1W: +12.01% | 1M: -0.85%) RECOVERY.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology & Telecom is the clear laggard: KONTR (1W: -19.37% | 1M: -32.80%) BELOW TREND, TCELL (1W: +5.27% | 1M: -1.85%) RECOVERY, TTKOM (not in top movers) under pressure. Energy & Chemicals and Heavy Industry have mixed performers but no systemic weakness.

## STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
YKBNK (1W: +14.82% | 1M: +0.60%) ABOVE TREND; TRMET (1W: +14.15% | 1M: +2.81%) ABOVE TREND; TKFEN (1W: +13.34% | 1M: +22.02%) ABOVE TREND; KRDMD (1W: +12.32% | 1M: +3.96%) ABOVE TREND; TAVHL (1W: +12.01% | 1M: -0.85%) RECOVERY.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
KONTR (1W: -19.37% | 1M: -32.80%) BELOW TREND; SASA (1W: -10.32% | 1M: -2.16%) BELOW TREND; VESTL (1W: -6.54% | 1M: +1.74%) CORRECTION; HEKTS (1W: -5.81% | 1M: -20.35%) BELOW TREND; HALKB (1W: -1.54% | 1M: +32.89%) CORRECTION.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
High-momentum names: YKBNK (1W: +14.82% | 1M: +0.60%) ABOVE TREND, TRMET (1W: +14.15% | 1M: +2.81%) ABOVE TREND, TKFEN (1W: +13.34% | 1M: +22.02%) ABOVE TREND, KRDMD (1W: +12.32% | 1M: +3.96%) ABOVE TREND, AKBNK (1W: +11.89% | 1M: +1.32%) ABOVE TREND.

## SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Banking Sector Outlook?**
Banking & Finance is the cycle leader: AKBNK (1W: +11.89% | 1M: +1.32%) ABOVE TREND, GARAN (1W: +10.67% | 1M: +0.90%) ABOVE TREND, ISCTR (1W: +11.62% | 1M: +9.29%) ABOVE TREND, VAKBN (1W: +11.60% | 1M: +9.33%) ABOVE TREND; watch HALKB (1W: -1.54% | 1M: +32.89%) CORRECTION for profit-taking risks.

**8. Industrial Sector Outlook?**
Heavy industry is mixed: EREGL (1W: +10.81% | 1M: +0.78%) ABOVE TREND, KRDMD (1W: +12.32% | 1M: +3.96%) ABOVE TREND, FROTO (1W: +5.16% | 1M: -0.13%) RECOVERY, while VESTL (1W: -6.54% | 1M: +1.74%) CORRECTION signals dispersion within the group.

**9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?**
Energy & Chemicals are mixed: TRMET (1W: +14.15% | 1M: +2.81%) ABOVE TREND and TUPRS (1W: +2.30% | 1M: +9.97%) ABOVE TREND show pockets of strength, but SASA (1W: -10.32% | 1M: -2.16%) BELOW TREND and HEKTS (1W: -5.81% | 1M: -20.35%) BELOW TREND warn of idiosyncratic risk.

## PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Risk-on tactical tilt: overweight selective banks and high-performing construction names (AKBNK, ISCTR, TKFEN) and add exposure to TRMET/KRDMD; underweight Technology & Telecom (KONTR) and weak chemicals (SASA, HEKTS). Keep position sizes disciplined and book partial gains on recent bank rallies.

## NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
AKBNK (1W: +11.89% | 1M: +1.32%) ABOVE TREND, ISCTR (1W: +11.62% | 1M: +9.29%) ABOVE TREND, TKFEN (1W: +13.34% | 1M: +22.02%) ABOVE TREND, TRMET (1W: +14.15% | 1M: +2.81%) ABOVE TREND, KONTR (1W: -19.37% | 1M: -32.80%) BELOW TREND for downside risk monitoring.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
Banking & Finance for leadership continuation and profit-taking; Construction & REIT for momentum confirmation; Technology & Telecom as a risk pocket to avoid or short if weakness continues.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Monitor XU100 momentum (watch for continued follow-through off this week’s highs), CBRT commentary and local FX moves, oil and commodity prices and Q3 earnings updates as primary catalysts. A failure to hold intra-week bank gains or a negative global risk impulse would flip the setup quickly.

## EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
RISK-ON market: Normal volatility (29.3%) with 7/8 sectors positive, led by banks and select industrials. Opportunity: overweight banks and high-momentum construction/industrial winners; Risk: concentrated downside in Technology & Telecom and idiosyncratic hits in chemicals.
